head: df9e122a
gate: STRICT_DNS and LOGICAL_DNS CDS cluster decoding and transactional SotW/delta publication
notes: STRICT_DNS and LOGICAL_DNS clusters carry an inline ClusterLoadAssignment whose cluster_name must match the cluster. Host endpoints retain priority and locality identity; the target builds priority and locality paths and applies the CDS endpoint policy, including xds_wrr_locality when configured. STRICT_DNS retains every declared endpoint per locality; LOGICAL_DNS retains one. DNS clusters request no EDS subscription. Native tests cover decode acceptance/rejection, strict/logical cardinality, SotW publication, delta publication, endpoint reprojection and absent EDS subscriptions.
